tweet_summary: A video claims Jake Paul is facing backlash for 'pulling this move' on Druski (a darker/blackface response to Druski's Erika Kirk parody), showing footage of Jake Paul appearing to imitate Druski.
why_note_decision: Jake Paul discussed on Theo Von's podcast that he was contacting makeup artists and considering a 'darker' response skit, but as of the post he had NOT released any such skit. The imitation footage circulating is AI-generated/deepfake, not from a real released skit. The post presents an unreleased idea + fake footage as an actual completed act, which misleads viewers.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the note establishes BOTH: (1) Jake Paul only DISCUSSED/considered a 'darker' (blackface) response to Druski on Theo Von's podcast and has not released an actual skit, AND (2) the imitation footage/image shown is AI-generated (deepfake), not real skit footage. It must avoid the original framing's failure of treating the move as already done. A note that only says 'this is real footage' or that omits the AI/unreleased distinction should FAIL. Cite reporting on the podcast remarks (e.g. thegrio/yahoo) for the 'discussed but not released' point.
reference_note: Jake Paul discussed planning a "darker" skit response to Druski on Theo Von's podcast but has not released it. The image shown is AI-generated, not from an actual skit. He faces backlash for the idea. https://thegrio.com/2026/04/06/jake-paul-weighs-controversial-reply-to-druski-skit-as-debate-over-comedy-boundaries-grows https://www.yahoo.com/entertainment/celebrity/articles/jake-paul-said-wants-blackface-162736267.html

fact_check.claim_verdict: misleading - Jake Paul only discussed a possible blackface response on a podcast and did not release a skit; circulating imitation footage is AI/deepfake
fact_check.notes: Multiple outlets confirm Paul said he 'wanted to do it back' and had been calling makeup artists, but as of 7 Apr 2026 no skit was filmed/released. Druski's whiteface 'conservative women' skit was real and viral (~180M views).

importance.lens_rationale: 2.7M impressions; mainly celebrity/race-comedy discourse, low world-stakes, but deepfake-as-real is a recurring epistemics problem worth correcting.
